background.value: White or off-white, plain, free of shadows, textures, or objects

head_height.value: 1 to 1-3/8 inches (25-35mm) from bottom of chin to top of head

validity.value: Photo must be taken within last 6 months; passport valid 10 years (adult 16+) / 5 years (child under 16)

file_spec.value: Printed: matte or glossy photo-quality paper, original only. Digital (online renewal): JPG/JPEG/PNG/HEIC/HEIF, 54KB-10MB. Visa digital: JPEG only, 600x600 to 1200x1200 pixels, max 240KB, 24-bit color sRGB, compression ratio <=20:1

clothing_restriction.value: No uniforms, camouflage, or wireless devices in/on ears. Remove anything covering face unless for documented religious or medical reasons

expression_restriction.value: Neutral facial expression, both eyes open and visible, mouth closed. Natural smile acceptable if eyes open and mouth closed

glasses_policy.value: Eyeglasses must be removed. Exception only with documented medical necessity requiring signed doctor's note. Sunglasses and tinted glasses never permitted

ears_visibility.value: Full face must be visible; no wireless devices in or on ears; hair cannot obstruct face

face_visibility.value: Full face must be visible, directly centered, facing camera. Head fully visible from chin to top of head. No face coverings except documented religious or medical reasons

headwear_policy.value: Prohibited except for religious or medical purposes (requires signed statement). If worn: full face must remain visible, no shadows cast, one solid color, no patterns or holes

accessories.value: Facial piercings acceptable if not hiding face. Jewelry allowed if not obscuring features. No wireless devices (earbuds, headphones). No face coverings or medical masks

is_white_background_allowed.value: Yes - white or off-white is the REQUIRED background color
